available_predefined_baselines.description: Approved semantic baseline for the products table defined in data architecture.

product_id.business_meaning: Unique identifier for a product listing

shop_id.business_meaning: Identifier of the shop that owns the product listing

category.business_meaning: Merchandise category assigned to the product

fabric.business_meaning: Main material or fabric used in the product

size_range.business_meaning: Size range supported by the product listing

price_LKR.business_meaning: Displayed selling price of the product in Sri Lankan Rupees

style_tags.business_meaning: Tag bundle describing product style, fit, and audience cues

created_ts.business_meaning: Original source time fragment captured when the product record was created
created_ts.value_direction: later means more recent source capture

popularity_score.business_meaning: Popularity score assigned to the product listing

stock_count.business_meaning: Available stock quantity for the product listing
stock_count.value_direction: higher means more items in stock

created_timestamp.business_meaning: Full timestamp when the product record was created
created_timestamp.value_direction: later means more recent record creation

available_predefined_baselines.description: Approved semantic baseline for the users table defined in data architecture.

user_id.business_meaning: Unique identifier for a customer account

email.business_meaning: Customer email address used for communication and login

phone.business_meaning: Customer phone number for delivery or support contact

shipping_address.business_meaning: Primary shipping address for the customer

signup_ts.business_meaning: Date when the customer account was created
signup_ts.value_direction: later means more recently signed up

is_active.business_meaning: Whether the customer account is currently active

available_predefined_baselines.description: Approved semantic baseline for the transactions table defined in data architecture.

user_id.business_meaning: Identifier of the customer who placed the order

product_id.business_meaning: Identifier of the product sold in the transaction

shop_id.business_meaning: Identifier of the shop fulfilling the order

quantity.business_meaning: Number of product units sold in the transaction

unit_price.business_meaning: Selling price per unit before taxes and discounts
unit_price.value_direction: higher means higher per-item selling price

total_amount.business_meaning: Gross transaction amount before discounts and taxes

discount_percent.business_meaning: Discount percentage applied to the transaction

discount_amount.business_meaning: Discount amount deducted from the gross transaction total

tax_percent.business_meaning: Tax percentage applied to the transaction

tax_amount.business_meaning: Tax amount added to the transaction

final_amount.business_meaning: Final sales revenue after applying discounts and taxes

payment_method.business_meaning: Payment method selected by the customer

transaction_status.business_meaning: Operational status of the transaction lifecycle
transaction_status.value_direction: later statuses mean more progressed fulfillment

transaction_date.business_meaning: Calendar date when the transaction was recorded
transaction_date.value_direction: later means more recent sale date

transaction_ts.business_meaning: Exact timestamp when the transaction was created
transaction_ts.value_direction: later means more recent transaction event

delivery_date.business_meaning: Expected or actual delivery date for the order

notes.business_meaning: Free-text note describing the order context

available_predefined_baselines.description: Approved semantic baseline for the shops table defined in data architecture.
